race.description: Wangaratta Bearings & Industrial Supplies Mdn Plate
race.comment: RAVENS GLOW (8) brings the strongest exposed profile, with three placings from four starts and a second at this track before a three-month break. She was beaten as favourite that day, but the comfortable Wangaratta trial points to a forward return and her overall consistency gives her the edge. I'M DA BOSS (2) is the race-fit danger after a first-up third at Hamilton, beaten just over half a length, and his repeated placings around 1100m make him a solid winning threat. PROLIFIC ANGEL (11) has more upside than his debut fifth at Werribee suggests, having won a Cranbourne trial for the Anthony and Sam Freedman stable since a five-month break.  DO THE DIRTY (10) is showing ability in his first campaign and a maiden win isn't out of the question here, back to 1100m suits nicely.
